description: Land Title Settlement Department - Koralawella, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520215 (23/0858)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, parcel numbers, extents, and legal status. The content focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
